content: Hello, we have a request from a researcher asking us to update their (SSO-provided) first name. In the campus directory I see a givenName that Dataverse is using, and an eduPersonNickname with the desired value. It is my understanding that Dataverse will update Shibboleth attributes in the DB at each sign-in, I'm curious how many installations have encountered such name change requests?
I think we always just explain that Dataverse will use givenName.

@Philip Durbin 🚀 we have a faculty member who says that he updated his e-mail address, but in the campus directory I see the same e-mail address that's stored in authenticateduser - Dataverse constructs the persistentuseridentifier using the IDP entityID and the EPPN, but Dataverse always matched on e-mail address. assuming he did change it, should I expect Dataverse to simply update the e-mail address?

Sorry, I'm having a little trouble following (late in a long day of interviews and release process) but yes, if the email is updated in the IdP, the next time he logs into Dataverse, the email should change in that table.
